prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle gain and strength improvement for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full 24-hour period with 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Total daily protein intake is at least 1.7g per kg of body weight (approximately 145g+)
Includes pre-workout and post-workout meals timed for optimal recovery and muscle synthesis
Macronutrient balance supports strength training with adequate carbohydrates and healthy fats
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) requiring high protein intake and balanced macronutrients with meal timing optimized for recovery and muscle synthesis

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight at 68 kg for lightweight boxing division while preserving strength and endurance for training
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No dairy due to lactose intolerance

solution_criteria: Plan totals approximately 2,200-2,400 calories to maintain current weight while supporting athletic performance
Includes minimum 120g protein distributed across meals to preserve muscle mass during weight maintenance
All meals and snacks are dairy-free and practical for a boxer's training schedule
Provides a complete 1-day structure with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and pre/post-training nutrition
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a weight-conscious athlete in a sport with weight categories (boxer or wrestler) requiring a calorie-controlled plan that maintains performance while meeting strict nutritional minimums

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate loading and strategic meal timing around a 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 3 meals plus pre/post-workout nutrition totaling 3000-3500 calories
Carbohydrates comprise 55-65% of total daily intake with concentrated portions 2-3 hours before and within 30 minutes after the run
All meals align with vegetarian diet and exclude nuts
Plan is presented in a compact, single-day format with clear timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading with specific timing around training windows
